content:
**Spoiled Fruit** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Spoiled Fruit will appear in the player character's inventory whenever a piece of edible fruit has fully rotted. Spoiled Fruit can be converted into Raw Fertilizer at a Chemistry Station, at a rate of 10 Spoiled Fruit for one Raw Fertilizer.

Replaces fruits in the player character's inventory when they become spoiled.
